name: Veritas
tagline: Affordable payment verification for small merchants: email checks, device fingerprinting and a fraud dashboard.

awards: Visa Truth and Trust Track Prize

problem: Chargebacks hurt small merchants who cannot afford enterprise fraud tools, the team says.
solution: A script sits between checkout and the processor to verify customers by email and score device risk; merchants see patterns and set rules.
demo_moment: Team-described: a demo store routes a risky payment through verification.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Visa Truth and Trust Track Prize” among 160 submissions.
Integrates in minutes for small merchants.

lessons: Name the customer who cannot afford the incumbent.
